title: DEFINE step 3 PR 5: --check shapes exit 4 policy and resolvedPaths resolve-on-disk
description: src/cli/readiness.js grows a bite-aware --check policy: --check shapes exits 4 on an unacknowledged D3 failure and 0 when the freeze record acknowledges define.shapes at the current tree hash; the warn-with-ack branch is kept for D5 and D6 until PRs 6 and 7 bite them. Before invoking computeReadiness the CLI collects candidate path tokens from in-scope TAC interface descriptions and passes a resolvedPaths map (local resolve on disk) through the stage context so the pure gate function shapes:pathsResolve can decide path existence without I/O. The decideExitCode helper reads ackable(stage) and the freeze.gates[<gate>] record to pick between 0 (warn-with-ack unacked or acked bite) and 4 (bite unacked at the current hash).
